flow.text: Digital Business Consultant

At PETA, I owned the data, set the process, reviewed the cuts; I owned the process end to end until I shifted towards scaling, optimizing, and future-proofing the visual and social first focus we established across the, now well-oiled, massive global machine. I valued the autonomy and agency I had worked hard for very much, and it wasn't until my mentor, whom I built everything with, left to start her own consultancy. Soon after she left I was talking with Chelsea Williams, a long time friend with whom I always ended up talking shop with. We shared strategies, advice, and pushed each other to grow. So when she told me she was doing the same as Helena, it started to seem like a viable option.
Selling Outcomes Not Hours

Having run every part of the digital-marketing spectrum, it seems logical to take on a similar challenge again, but for a SMO who need a consultant who could own every process end to end, building out her entire digital business.
Hawaii Physicians Urgent Need for COVID-19 PPE

Before digging into things with my first client, I was hit with some urgent work coming up with a solution to help coordinate the very limited supply of PPE in Hawaii for Physicians during the COVID-19 pandemic.

flow.text: Brand Designer & Web Developer

At PETA, the work I was proudest of was building the organization's brand voice and visual identity and carrying it cleanly across every medium it touched. Consulting was the chance to do that whole job again, start to finish, for one client at a time.
Carrying One Brand Across Every Medium

CK Heals is the clearest example: she's a client I've been working with since 2019. I built her brand's voice, drew its aesthetics, and set up all the different digital mediums she needed. There were times when she needed copywriting, running ads, or help learning how to use new social media platforms. She would send me pictures or direct me to her Instagram so that everything I made for her truly spoke with her personality.
10 Years of Client Growth & Change

When I met this client, she was pioneering as one of the first personal trainers that were moving their business onto video chat. She has only continued to keep growing, learning new modalities, and evolving her practice, and I've been there to adapt her online brand and properties every step of the way.

achievements.headline: 10-year client relationship with CK Heals
achievements.details: Continuous brand voice, websites, ads, courses, and testimonial systems built and rebuilt for one client since 2019 — from her first 'Skype Personal Training' site through a hand-drawn Webflow brand to an in-progress AI-assisted redesign for her next chapter.

achievements.headline: Hawaii Physicians PPE platform live in hours
achievements.details: A frantic phone call became a Squarespace + Mailchimp coordination platform connecting providers across the state with the limited PPE supply, picked up by local news and kept in use for weeks ahead of any government effort.

achievements.headline: Visitors averaged 14 minutes on one testimonials page.
achievements.details: Web analytics surprised both of us — visitors spent an average of 14 minutes on the testimonials page alone, which directly reshaped the next redesign around proof-of-results and ultimately let the client retire an expensive course platform.
